description.en-US:
Prompt Heart is the home for the AI prompts that work. Save them like notes, fill in the
blanks, and copy any prompt in one tap. Then jump straight into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini,
Grok, Perplexity and more.

* One tap to copy any prompt from the home screen, with pins, search and #tags
* A library of 100 ready-made prompts for images, work, writing, code and more
* Templates: write {{placeholders}} once and fill them in with a live preview
* Copy & open: copies your prompt and opens your AI app, ready to paste
* Categories, tags, bulk select, version history and a 30-day Trash
* A profile with your most-used prompts, a year of activity, streaks and achievements
* Import from spreadsheets, Notion, JSON or Markdown, and export as CSV
* Share text or images from any app into Prompt Heart, or share your profile card
* Works fully offline; an optional free account syncs across devices
* Light, dark or system theme, accent colours, list or grid layout
* No ads, no analytics, no tracking

Privacy policy: https://inigo-code.github.io/prompt-heart-site/privacy.html

Prompt Heart is an independent app. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI,
Anthropic, Google, xAI, Perplexity, Microsoft, DeepSeek or Mistral AI.
